circuits.name: monza
circuits.note: Newer Digital 132 plan format ('Autodromo Nazionale di Monza'); PDF contains only the parts table with 8-digit article numbers, no assembled dimensions or track length printed. Counts are individual single tracks required. Includes digital lane-change parts and Control Unit.

circuits.name: suzuka
circuits.note: Newer Digital 132 plan format ('Suzuka International Racing Course'); PDF contains only the parts table with 8-digit article numbers, no assembled dimensions or track length printed. Counts are individual single tracks required. Includes Control Unit.

notes: Older 'Circuits to Download' PDFs (Zeltweg, Brands Hatch, Catalunya, Interlagos) use 5-digit Exclusiv/Evolution item numbers and state dimensions + track length with European decimal commas (converted to dots here).
Brands Hatch PDF is the German-language 'Streckenvorschlag' variant (Groesse 4,5 x 5,10m; Streckenlaenge ca. 20,323m).
Part descriptions like 'Standard straights 4 pieces' refer to retail pack size; the Track Parts counts recorded here are individual pieces as printed in the PDFs.

Additional plans available at the index page but not captured: Carrera 2015 World Final (333682), 2014 Nuremberg Trade Fair (333683), Challenge Tour 2012 (333684), Bugatti Le Mans (333686), Magny-Cours (333689), Zandvoort (660963).
